(3) AI at Design Time! AI at Runtime?

AI at Design Time AI at Runtime
  • Recognizes patterns
  • Writes the code
  • You review and ship
  • Runs deterministically forever after
  • Use it aggressively
  • Great tool for genuine judgment tasks
  • Great tool for unstructured input at scale
  • Real value where no non-AI option exists
  • Costly per call — budget deliberately
  • Handle with care

(7) Plenty of API Lifecycle Tooling

  • Design tools to help create and discuss APIs
  • Validation tools to make sure APIs adhere to guidelines
  • Mocking tools to generate APIs from descriptions
  • Testing tools to validate implementations against descriptions
  • Fuzzing tools to test APIs for robustness
  • Documentation tools to create API documentation
  • Code generation tools for client and server sides

Conclusions Erik Wilde: Module 6: Building APIs in the Age of AI

(14) AI Shortens Every Loop

  • Every stage of the lifecycle now has AI assistance available
  • Faster iteration means more iterations, not just earlier delivery
  • More iterations is how API quality actually improves
  • This is design time: review the output, then ship something deterministic
